div.div:
Steps
1. Switchboard / Amp
GitLab ops plane patches the tenant.
2. Single-tenant account
Isolation unit = AWS GovCloud account.
3. Sharded Gitaly
No Praefect — EBS snapshot DR.
4. Outside tenant
IdP, FIPS runners, self-hosted AI Gateway.
